content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: RMLIMS has advertised 74 vacancies across six posts under Group B, C and D. The Programmer, Medical Physicist and Radiation Safety Officer posts fall under Group B; Stenographer and Receptionist fall under Group C; and Hospital Attendant Grade-II falls under Group D. The category-wise breakup for each post is given in parentheses in the table below. In addition, horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is provided: 1 post each in Receptionist, Stenographer and Hospital Attendant Gr-II categories. The Institute has clarified that the number of advertised vacancies may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates who are Indian nationals and meet the post-wise qualification and experience requirements as on the last date of application are eligible to apply. The table below lists the qualification for each post. Note: AERB refers to the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board. Where experience is an essential criterion, only post-qualification experience will be considered valid, and candidates must submit an experience certificate on the institute/hospital/agency letterhead with the letter number, date of issue, and number of beds in the hospital.

rows.qualification_experience_requirements: B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science/Computer Engineering) or Post Graduation in Computer Application

Postgraduate degree in Physics + PG Diploma in Radiological/Medical Physics + 12-month internship in a recognized radiation therapy department; OR Basic science degree with Physics as main subject + Postgraduate degree in Radiological/Medical Physics + 12-month internship

Postgraduate degree in Physics + PG Diploma in Radiological/Medical Physics + 12-month internship + RSO qualification as per AERB norms; OR Basic science degree with Physics as main subject + Postgraduate degree in Radiological/Medical Physics + 12-month internship + RSO qualification as per AERB norms
Essential: 10th Standard pass. Desirable: Experience of having worked in a Civil or Military Hospital, or in a Nursing Home, or with a Medical Practitioner

Graduate or equivalent from a recognized University (above 55%) with speed of 80 w.p.m. in Hindi & English stenography and 40/35 w.p.m. in English and Hindi typing, plus knowledge of computer applications. In absence of bilingual stenography candidates, English Stenography candidates may be considered eligible

Essential: Degree from a recognized University + Post-Graduate Diploma in Journalism/Public Relations. Desirable: Experience in Public Relations/Publications/Printing/Publishing and exposure to working on a Personal Computer

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates need to pay a non-refundable application fee online as per their category. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and separate fee for each post. Candidates covered under horizontal (other category) reservation must pay the fee applicable to their own original category. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: For all posts mentioned in this recruitment, candidates must have attained the age of 18 years and must not have attained the age of 40 years as on the last date of submission of the online application. SC/ST/OBC and other specified categories of Uttar Pradesh: upper age relaxation as specified by the Government, maximum up to 5 years as per relevant Government Orders Permanent government employees with at least 3 years of regular and continuous service in the relevant field: relaxation up to 5 years Physically handicapped candidates (General category): up to 5 years for Group-B posts and 10 years for Group-C posts Physically handicapped candidates (OBC/SC/ST): up to 10 years for Group-B posts and 15 years for Group-C posts Ex-servicemen and dependents of Freedom Fighters: relaxation as per Government of India rules This age relaxation is admissible only to candidates who are domicile of Uttar Pradesh; candidates from other states are eligible to apply only against Unreserved (UR) vacancies

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), conducted bilingually in Hindi and English. Screening Examination: Qualifying in nature, held only to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks from this stage are not carried forward, and only 10 times the number of advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted for the Main Exam Main Examination: Final selection is based solely on marks obtained in this exam, prepared category-wise based on merit and reservation norms Exam Pattern: Both Screening and Mains exams carry 100 marks each, of 2 hours' duration, consisting only of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) — 60 marks on the subject related to the post, 10 marks each on General English, General Knowledge, Reasoning, and Mathematical Aptitude Negative Marking: 1 mark is awarded for each correct answer; 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer Qualifying Marks: 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates; 40% for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates Skill Test: Conducted after the Main Exam for the Stenographer post (Stenography/Typing Test in English or Hindi, Mangal or Krutidev 10 font). Candidates equal to five times the advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted; the Skill Test is qualifying in nature and its marks are not counted in the final merit

faq.question: Q1. What is RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 is a direct recruitment drive by Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow for 74 Group B, C and D non-teaching posts, filled through a Computer Based Test (CBT).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 74 vacancies are available across Programmer, Medical Physicist, Radiation Safety Officer, Hospital Attendant Gr-II, Stenographer, and Receptionist posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - ranging from 10th pass for Hospital Attendant Gr-II to postgraduate degrees for Medical Physicist and Radiation Safety Officer. Full post-wise qualification is listed in the Eligibility Criteria section above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years of age as on the last date of application submission, with age relaxation applicable to reserved categories as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹1180/- (including GST) for UR/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹708/- (including GST) for SC/ST candidates. Persons with Disabilities are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website www.drrmlims.ac.in once the application link is activated, by completing registration, filling the form, uploading documents, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Screening Examination followed by a Main Examination (both CBT-based), and a Skill Test for the Stenographer post. Final selection is based only on Main Examination marks.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from a basic pay of ₹18,000/- (Level-1, Hospital Attendant Gr-II) to ₹56,100/- (Level-10, Programmer/Medical Physicist/Radiation Safety Officer), plus other admissible allowances.
